component.name: Javelin Mail
component.summary: KDE-focused JMAP mail, contacts, calendar, and Sieve client

description.p: Javelin Mail is a native KDE desktop client for JMAP mail, contacts, calendars, submission, and Sieve. It combines a responsive cache-backed interface with a lightweight daemon for synchronization, notifications, delayed sending, and complete offline mailbox copies.
The interface uses KDE menus, configurable toolbars, standard actions, KTextEditor, Plasma tray integration, desktop notifications, and KDE theme and icon conventions.
